methodology.memory: Linux ru_maxrss whole-process high-water RSS including native allocations; NOT model-only RAM or system memory
methodology.cache: Fresh model process, not an OS filesystem cold-cache benchmark; caches are not flushed
methodology.quality: Text-only qualitative comparison; no human reference or listening-based accuracy measurement
